findings.claim: TI held an estimated 17.8%-19% share of the global analog semiconductor market in 2025, the industry-leading position ahead of ADI and Infineon.
findings.source: Analog Semiconductors Market Size & Share 2026-2035 (gminsights.com)

findings.claim: TI began production at the first module of its Sherman, TX 300mm fab in December 2025 (65nm/130nm analog nodes for smartphone power-management ICs) and announced in February 2026 a second cleanroom module adding 20,000 wafer starts/month by 2028, expanding low-cost in-house capacity ahead of the industry.
findings.source: BingX/TI newsroom coverage of Sherman fab expansion

findings.claim: Over the past five years, Chinese domestic analog vendors (e.g., SG Micro, 3Peak) have gradually eroded overseas incumbents' (including TI's) share in telecom and consumer-electronics segments, driven by geopolitical friction and China's domestic-substitution push, though their overlap is concentrated in TI's mid-to-low-end part numbers rather than the full portfolio.
findings.source: Chinese analog chip vendors brace for impact as Texas Instruments slashes prices (jw.ijiwei.com); Citrini Research "Semis Memo: Supply Chain Inheritance"

findings.claim: TI, NXP and Infineon raised analog IC prices effective April 2026 (TI hikes up to 85% on select parts), and TI announced a third sweeping price increase in May 2026 effective July 1, 2026. Analysts flagged that end customers seeking to avoid TI's price hikes may accelerate adoption of Chinese domestic alternatives, especially in long-cycle industrial and automotive sectors.
findings.source: BigGo Finance: "Texas Instruments' Third Price Hike in Six Months Ignites New Analog Chip Cycle, Opening Triple-Bonanza Window for China's Domestic Substitution"

findings.claim: Hudson Labs' 2026 TXN peer comparison notes TI has recently gained share in China (roughly 22% of TI's total revenue) even as local Chinese competition becomes faster and more capable, describing the China dynamic as a net share gain for TI so far.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Competitors: TXN Peers 2026 (hudson-labs.com)

competitive_share_entrants.note: Mixed picture: TI holds/extends #1 global analog share and is gaining in China near-term, but Chinese domestic vendors (SG Micro, 3Peak) are structurally eroding share in overlapping mid/low-end telecom & consumer segments, and TI's 2026 price hikes create an opening analysts flag as accelerating customer migration to local alternatives in industrial/auto.

findings.claim: TI's revenue base is structurally diversified: no single customer accounts for more than 10% of sales, TI sells to more than 100,000 customers, and over 40% of revenue comes from outside its top 100 customers — a structural mitigant against single-customer second-sourcing or in-house insourcing risk that would materially move total revenue.
findings.source: Texas Instruments 2025 Annual Report / Notice of 2026 Annual Meeting (SEC filing, investor.ti.com)

findings.claim: TXN FY2025 Form 10-K (filed with SEC 2026-02-06) discloses TI sells to over 100,000 customers, with roughly half of total revenue coming from customers outside its top 50 — i.e. no material single-customer or small-group revenue concentration disclosed.
findings.source: Texas Instruments FY2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR (filed 2026-02-06)

findings.claim: TI's FY2025 10-K states more than 80% of 2025 revenue was direct (including TI.com), a continued shift away from distributor-based sales that increases TI's visibility into true end-customer demand and reduces distributor-channel inventory opacity.
findings.source: Texas Instruments FY2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR

findings.claim: TI Q1 2026 results (reported 2026-04-22): automotive revenue grew ~5% YoY to approximately $797M, the first YoY automotive growth after seven consecutive quarters of decline; management attributed the inflection to completed customer destocking and low customer inventory levels across auto/industrial end markets.
findings.source: TI Q1 2026 earnings release and earnings call, investor.ti.com

findings.claim: TI management cautioned in Q1 2026 commentary that customer inventory depletion appears complete but 'any renewed economic weakness could trigger another destocking phase' — i.e. end-customer macro-demand risk (not a TI-specific customer credit event) has not been eliminated.
findings.source: TI Q1 2026 earnings commentary (Yahoo Finance / Globe and Mail republication of TI investor materials)

findings.claim: Industry commentary argues current oversupply in legacy/mature-node semiconductors (including analog) is masking a structural supply deficit expected to emerge in 2026-2027, driven by inventory correction from prior overordering plus years of capex concentrated in advanced logic nodes (3nm/2nm at TSMC/Samsung/Intel) while mature-node capacity needed for automotive/industrial was underinvested.
findings.source: Future Digest News (Substack), "Mature Semiconductors: The Silent Shortage Blocking Everything"

findings.claim: TI Q2 FY2026 earnings call: above-seasonal Q3 2026 revenue guidance ($5.65B-$6.15B) combined with the company's first price increases 'in years' across analog products; Futurum Group's analysis frames this combination as a signal that the current recovery is a broad industry upcycle rather than a pure inventory-restocking bounce.
findings.source: Futurum Group, "Texas Instruments Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Broad-based Analog Growth"

findings.claim: TI's six-year, $20B+ capacity buildout (new fabs in Sherman, TX and a retooled embedded-processing fab in Lehi, UT, part of a $60B announced US manufacturing investment) is now complete; 2026 capex guidance was cut sharply to $2-3B (down from peak-cycle spend) even as demand recovers broadly — TI is not re-accelerating capacity investment despite the upturn.
findings.source: TechTarget / Manufacturing Dive coverage of TI's $60B US semiconductor manufacturing investment; TI Q1/Q2 2026 earnings guidance

findings.claim: TI Q2 FY2026 results showed broad-based demand recovery: data-center revenue roughly doubled YoY, industrial demand recovered, and automotive re-accelerated — described by Futurum Group as the recovery broadening 'beyond data-center infrastructure and initial industrial restocking' into a company-wide upcycle; gross margin rose 340bp sequentially on higher factory loadings.
findings.source: Futurum Group, "Texas Instruments Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Broad-based Analog Growth"

findings.claim: 中國半導體行業協會（CSIA）發布通知，明確以晶圓廠（wafer fabrication facility）所在地認定晶片原產地以適用對美關稅；由於 TI 晶片多在美國本土廠生產，被認定為對中國關稅特別敏感的美系晶片廠之一，TXN 股價當日重挫 9% 至 $142.66，為 2020 年 3 月以來單日最大跌幅。

findings.claim: 中國對美進口商品加徵 34% 全面關稅（貿易戰升級），對高度依賴中國需求的美系晶片廠（含 TI）構成利潤率壓縮與市占流失風險；委外代工（outsource manufacturing）的美系晶片廠則被中國官方協會排除在報復性關稅之外，形成自有晶圓廠（IDM，如 TI）相對代工客戶的競爭劣勢。
findings.source: stocktwits.com "US Chipmakers Who Outsource Manufacturing To Be Exempt From China Tariffs, Says State-Backed Association"

findings.claim: TI 已提供「特殊產品流程」（specialized product flows），以現有產品組合內的替代料號（alternate part numbers）因應潛在關稅衝擊；同時公司持續推進 300mm 美國本土晶圓廠擴產計畫，目標降低單位成本並提升工業、車用與 AI 應用的供應韌性。
findings.source: TI.com import details page; Yahoo Finance "Texas Instruments (TXN) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why"
